intro: Gath'Ilzogg is the fearsome Blackrock orc warlord who commands the invasion force occupying Stonewatch Keep in the Redridge Mountains. Under his brutal leadership, the orcs seized the fortress and launched devastating raids against the town of Lakeshire, earning him an urgent bounty from the town's desperate magistrate.

p: Gath'Ilzogg marched north out of the Burning Steppes under orders to secure Redridge for the Blackrock clan. Aided by the foul sorcery of the renegade human warlock Morganth, Gath'Ilzogg's warband battered the defenders of Stonewatch Keep and seized the high ground overlooking the entire region. From this entrenched redoubt, he oversees aggressive raids into the valleys and down toward the bridge of Lakeshire, steadily suffocating the human settlement. He rarely fights alone, keeping elite Blackrock guards and a vicious black dragon whelp named Singe close at hand.
